blocks.heading: Teamlease Press Release Says Net Employment

items.text: A TeamLease press release says net employment change in fintech was 4.5 percent in the second half of 2025, up from 3.4 percent in the first half.

supporting: A TeamLease press release says net employment change in fintech was 4.5 percent in the second half of 2025, up from 3.4 percent in the first half. It credits clearer digital lending rules, the rollout of high-value UPI transactions and wider use of embedded finance.
